description: Verify ambiguous specification fields are flagged with [?] in the definition file rather than causing the skill to ask a clarifying question
expected_behavior: Accepts the generic name 'helper' without asking the user to clarify the agent's purpose
Writes a definition file at .smaqit/definitions/agents/helper.md with a best-effort inferred specification
Suffixes at least one genuinely ambiguous field value with [?] and a brief inline note explaining the uncertainty
Lists the [?]-annotated items in its final report with a suggested resolution for each
forbidden_behavior: Asks the user what the agent's purpose or domain should be instead of inferring and flagging it
Refuses to compile because the name is too generic
